pages.title: Brian Boru, the Warrior King - Dubray Books
pages.description:
Learn about the life and times of Brian Ború in the second book in John & Fatti Burke's Little Library

Get ready to make your knowledge a bit bigger by learning all about the warrior king that was Brian Ború.

Brian Ború grew up in a large warrior family over 1,000 years ago in Killaloe, Co Clare. One of twelve sons, Brian and his brothers practiced raids on other counties from the River Shannon. Eventually, Brian's army and navy grew to be so big that he became King of all Ireland. But up in Dublin, the Vikings were invading. So he gathered his men and went into battle …
